DIAGNOSIS READY: Hypertensive Emergency with Papilledema and Hypertensive Retinopathy.

The combination of progressive headache, worsening vision, constricting visual fields, and bilateral retinal hemorrhages on perimetry, in the absence of a mass lesion on MRI, strongly supports a diagnosis of severe hypertension causing hypertensive retinopathy and potentially ischemic optic neuropathy.
